notes.title: Update: Minor Improvements to Stroke Making

notes.title: 🎾 Update Alert: Toonie Tennis Just Got Faster, Funnier, and Way More Intense!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
We’ve been listening to your feedback, and we’re excited to serve up a speedy new update! 💨

🚀 What’s New?

Faster Animations: Moves now feel snappier, tighter, and more satisfying. Your character reacts like they’ve had three espressos.

Longer Rallies: We’ve tweaked gameplay to reward timing and skill, so you can enjoy those epic back-and-forth moments that feel just right.

More Responsive Feel: Movement, shots, and reactions are now ultra-smooth—less delay, more oomph. You’ll feel the difference the moment you step on the court.

Basically? Toonie Tennis is now more toonie than ever.

⚡ Whether you're in it for the glory, the giggles, or just to melt your controller with ridiculous rallies, this update brings the heat.

Thanks for playing and smashing—it means a ton!
Let us know what you think, and keep those serves spicy! 🔥🎾
— rGyani Games

notes.title: Final Build Transition
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the official release of Toonie Tennis! After extensive testing and feedback from the pre-release version, we've made significant improvements, bug fixes, and additions to provide the ultimate tennis experience.

[b]New Features:[/b]
* [b]Official Launch[/b]: The game is now fully launched and available for everyone!

[b]Improvements:[/b]
* [b]Visual Enhancements:[/b] Enhanced court surfaces, realistic player models for a more immersive experience.
* [b]AI Adjustments:[/b] Refined AI opponent behavior to offer a more challenging and strategic match.
* [b]Performance Optimizations:[/b] Reduced loading times and increased frame rates across all systems for smoother gameplay.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
* Fixed several crashes that occurred during match transitions and menu navigation.
* Resolved visual glitches in character animations and certain court textures.

[b]Gameplay Tweaks:[/b]
* [b]Rally System:[/b] Tweaked rally dynamics and shot timing for more responsive controls and realistic ball physics.
* [b]Serving Mechanics:[/b] Refined serving system for more control over speed, placement, and spin.
* [b]Match Balancing:[/b] Fine-tuned difficulty levels, game pacing, and scoring for a more balanced experience.

We are continuing to monitor and improve gameplay experiences for all players. Thank you to our community for your invaluable feedback and support throughout development! We look forward to seeing you on the court and hearing your thoughts as we continue to improve Toonie Tennis.
